_comment: Mock-exam library configuration. `year` is the stable identifier — it keys the question file (mock-exam-<year>.json), the attempt document under users/{uid}/mockExamAttempts, and the ?year= URL parameter, so it must never change. `label` is what the user sees: the admissions cycle the paper belongs to. Change `freeYear` to designate which year is accessible to free-tier users. All other years are locked behind paid access (users['exam-bank'] === 'paid'), except admins and reviewers who always see everything.
